# Code of conduct

## Our standard

Leadzy Studio welcomes contributors in Portuguese or English. We want project
spaces to be useful, respectful, and safe for people of different backgrounds
and levels of experience.

Examples of constructive participation include:

- giving specific, actionable, and kind technical feedback;
- assuming good intent while discussing evidence and tradeoffs;
- respecting privacy, attribution, licenses, and project boundaries;
- helping new contributors understand the workflow;
- accepting responsibility, apologizing, and correcting course after a mistake.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized
attention, deliberate intimidation, doxxing or sharing private information,
personal attacks, sustained disruption, and publishing another person's code,
media, or communications without permission.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions, comments, commits,
issues, and other participation that violates this standard. Proportionate
responses may include a private warning, temporary limits, or a permanent ban
from project spaces.

Report conduct concerns privately through Leadzy's contact channel at
<https://leadzy.com.br>. Do not include sensitive personal data beyond what is
needed to understand the report. Maintainers will handle reports as privately
as reasonably possible and will avoid conflicts of interest when deciding a
response.

This policy applies in repository spaces and when someone publicly represents
the Leadzy Studio project. It is informed by the Contributor Covenant 2.1,
available under CC BY 4.0 at <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/>.
